### FSH Items

#### Structure of FSH Items

A central purpose of FSH is to create and define items that represent and can be translated into FHIR artifacts. The general pattern used to define an item in FSH is:

* Declaration statement
* Keyword statements
* Rule statements

While every FSH item requires a declaration, depending on the item type, keyword statements and rules may not be required, or even permitted.

##### Declaration Statements

Declaration statements follow the syntax:

```
{declaration}: {value}
```

A declaration is always the first statement in an item definition. The value represents the item's name or identifier (id), depending on the item's type, as shown in the table below:

<a id="t4"></a>**Table 4. Declarations defined by FSH**

| Declaration | Creates... | Data Type |
|----------|---------|---------|
| [Alias](06-items-aliases.md#defining-aliases)           | An alias for a URL or OID | expression |
| [CodeSystem](07-items-code-systems.md#defining-code-systems) | A code system | name |
| [Extension](08-items-extensions.md#defining-extensions)    | An extension | name |
| [Instance](09-items-instances.md#defining-instances)      | An instance | id |
| [Invariant](10-items-invariants.md#defining-invariants)    | An invariant | id |
| [Logical](11-items-logical-models.md#defining-logical-models) | A logical model | name |
| [Mapping](12-items-mappings.md#defining-mappings)        | A mapping | id |
| [Profile](13-items-profiles.md#defining-profiles)        | A profile | name |
| [Resource](14-items-resources.md#defining-resources) | A custom resource | name |
| [RuleSet](15-items-rule-sets.md#defining-rule-sets)       | A set of rules that can be reused | name |
| [ValueSet](16-items-value-sets.md#defining-value-sets)     | A value set | name |

##### Keyword Statements

Keyword statements directly follow the declaration and precede any rules. Keyword statements follow the syntax:

```
{keyword}: {value}
```

The following keywords (case-sensitive) are defined:

<a id="t5"></a>**Table 5. Keywords defined by FSH**

| Keyword | Purpose | Data Type |
|----------|---------|---------|
| Characteristics [TU] | Specifies characteristics for logical models | codes |
| Context [TU] | Specifies context for extensions | FHIRPath strings and element paths |
| Description | Provides a human-readable description | string or markdown |
| Expression | Provides a FHIR path expression in an invariant | FHIRPath string |
| Id | Provides an identifier for an item | id |
| InstanceOf | Names the profile, resource, or logical model^* an instance instantiates | name or id or url |
| Parent | Names the base definition for a profile or extension | name or id or url |
| Severity | Specifies whether violation of an invariant represents an error or a warning | code |
| Source | Provides the profile the mapping applies to | name |
| Target | Provides the standard being mapped to | uri |
| Title | Provides a short human-readable name | string |
| Usage | Specifies how an instance is intended to be used in the IG | code |
| XPath | Provides the XPath in an invariant | XPath string |

[TU] ^* Defining instances of logical models in FSH is [TU].

In the above, "name" refers to a valid [item name](03-language-basics.md#item-names) and "id" to an [item identifier](03-language-basics.md#item-identifiers).

Depending on the type of item being defined, keywords may be REQUIRED, suggested (SHOULD be used), OPTIONAL, or prohibited (MUST NOT be used). The following table shows the relationship between declarations and keywords:

<a id="t6"></a>**Table 6. Relationships between declarations and keywords in FSH**

|            Keyword →<br/>Declaration ↓ | Id  | Description   | Title | Parent | InstanceOf | Usage | Source | Target | Severity      | Expression | XPath | Context [TU]| Characteristics [TU]|
|----------------------------------------|-----|---------------|-------|--------|------------|-------|--------|--------|---------------|------------|-------|---------|-----------------|
[Alias](06-items-aliases.md#defining-aliases)               |     |               |       |        |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |         |                 |
[Code System](07-items-code-systems.md#defining-code-systems)    |  S  |     S         |   S   |        |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |         |                 |
[Extension](08-items-extensions.md#defining-extensions)        |  S  |     S         |   S   |   O    |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |    S    |                 |
[Instance](09-items-instances.md#defining-instances)          |     |     S         |   S   |        |     R      |   O   |        |        |               |            |       |         |                 |
[Invariant](10-items-invariants.md#defining-invariants)        |     | S^1 |       |        |            |       |        |        | O^2 |     O      |   O   |         |                 |
[Logical](11-items-logical-models.md#defining-logical-models)      |  S  |     S         |   S   |   O    |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |         |        O        |
[Mapping](12-items-mappings.md#defining-mappings)            |  S  |     S         |   S   |        |            |       |   R    |   R    |               |            |       |         |                 |
[Profile](13-items-profiles.md#defining-profiles)            |  S  |     S         |   S   |   R    |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |         |                 |
[Resource](14-items-resources.md#defining-resources)          |  S  |     S         |   S   |   O    |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |         |                 |
[Rule Set](15-items-rule-sets.md#defining-rule-sets)          |     |               |       |        |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |         |                 |
[Value Set](16-items-value-sets.md#defining-value-sets)        |  S  |     S         |   S   |        |            |       |        |        |               |            |       |         |                 |

**KEY:**  R = REQUIRED, S = suggested (SHOULD be used), O = OPTIONAL, blank = prohibited (MUST NOT be used)

[TU] ^1 If the `Description` keyword is not specified in an `Invariant` definition, then an assignment rule for the `human` element MUST be specified instead.
<br/>
[TU] ^2 If the `Severity` keyword is not specified in an `Invariant` definition, then an assignment rule for the `severity` element MUST be specified instead.

For additional information about the use of these keywords, consult the documentation pertaining to the specific item(s) to which they apply.

##### Rule Statements

A number of rules usually follow the keyword statements. The grammar and meaning of different rule types are discussed in the [FSH Rules](17-rules-rule-order.md#fsh-rules) section. Without defining the rule types here, the following table shows the applicability of rule types to item types:

<a id="t7"></a>**Table 7. Relationships between FSH items and FSH rules**

|              Item →<br/>Rule Type ↓ | [Alias](06-items-aliases.md#defining-aliases) | [Code System](07-items-code-systems.md#defining-code-systems) | [Extension](08-items-extensions.md#defining-extensions) | [Instance](09-items-instances.md#defining-instances) | [Invariant](10-items-invariants.md#defining-invariants) | [Logical](11-items-logical-models.md#defining-logical-models) | [Mapping](12-items-mappings.md#defining-mappings) | [Profile](13-items-profiles.md#defining-profiles) | [Resource](14-items-resources.md#defining-resources) | [Rule Set](15-items-rule-sets.md#defining-rule-sets) | [Value Set](16-items-value-sets.md#defining-value-sets) |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------|---|---|---|---|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Add Element](19-rules-add-element.md#add-element-rules)                                  |   |   |   |   |                                    | Y                                  |   |   | Y | Y |   |
| [Assignment](20-rules-assignment.md#assignment-rules)                                    |   | C | Y | Y | [TU] Y  | [TU] Y  |   | Y | C | Y | C |
| [Binding](21-rules-binding.md#binding-rules)                                          |   |   | Y |   |                                    | [TU] Y  |   | Y | A | Y |   |
| [Cardinality](22-rules-cardinality.md#cardinality-rules)                                  |   |   | Y |   |                                    | [TU] Y  |   | Y | A | Y |   |
| [Contains (inline extensions)](23-rules-contains-rules-for-extensions.md#contains-rules-for-extensions)     |   |   | Y |   |                                    |                                    |   |   |   | Y |   |
| [Contains (standalone extensions)](23-rules-contains-rules-for-extensions.md#contains-rules-for-extensions) |   |   | Y |   |                                    |                                    |   | Y |   | Y |   |
| [Contains (slicing)](24-rules-contains-rules-for-slicing.md#contains-rules-for-slicing)                  |   |   | Y |   |                                    |                                    |   | Y |   | Y |   |
| [Exclude](25-rules-exclude.md#exclude-rules)                                          |   |   |   |   |                                    |                                    |   |   |   | Y | Y |
| [Flag](26-rules-flag.md#flag-rules)                                                |   |   | Y |   |                                    | L                                  |   | Y | L | Y |   |
| [Include](27-rules-include.md#include-rules)                                          |   |   |   |   |                                    |                                    |   |   |   | Y | Y |
| [Insert](28-rules-insert.md#insert-rules)                                            |   | Y | Y | Y | [TU] Y  | Y                                  | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y |
| [Local Code](29-rules-local-code.md#local-code-rules)                                    |   | Y |   |   |                                    |                                    |   |   |   | Y |   |
| [Mapping](30-rules-mapping.md#mapping-rules)                                          |   |   |   |   |                                    |                                    | Y |   |   | Y |   |
| [Obeys](31-rules-obeys.md#obeys-rules)                                              |   |   | Y |   |                                    | Y                                  |   | Y | Y | Y |   |
| [Path](32-rules-path.md#path-rules)                                                |   |   | Y | Y | [TU] Y  | Y                                  | Y | Y | Y | Y |   |
| [Type](33-rules-type.md#type-rules)                                                |   |   | Y |   |                                    | [TU] Y  |   | Y | A | Y |   |

**KEY:** Y = Rule type MAY be used, L = All flags except must support (`MS`) are supported, C = Assignments apply only to [caret paths](04-paths.md#caret-paths), A = Rules can only be applied to elements defined by the item (not inherited elements), blank = prohibited.
